20: ## Main statements
21: 
22:   - `trichotomy (p : ℝ≥0∞) : p = 0 ∨ p = ∞ ∨ 0 < p.toReal`: often used for `WithLp` and `lp`
23:   - `dichotomy (p : ℝ≥0∞) [Fact (1 ≤ p)] : p = ∞ ∨ 1 ≤ p.toReal`: often used for `WithLp` and `lp`
24:   - `toNNReal_iInf` through `toReal_sSup`: these declarations allow for easy conversions between
25:     indexed or set infima and suprema in `ℝ`, `ℝ≥0` and `ℝ≥0∞`. This is especially useful because
26:     `ℝ≥0∞` is a complete lattice.
27: -/
28: 
29: @[expose] public section
30: 
31: assert_not_exists Finset
32: 
33: open Set NNReal ENNReal
34: 
35: namespace ENNReal
36: 
37: section Real
38: 
39: variable {a b c d : ℝ≥0∞} {r p q : ℝ≥0}
40: 
41: theorem toReal_add (ha : a ≠ ∞) (hb : b ≠ ∞) : (a + b).toReal = a.toReal + b.toReal := by
42:   lift a to ℝ≥0 using ha
43:   lift b to ℝ≥0 using hb
44:   rfl
45: 
46: theorem toReal_add_le : (a + b).toReal ≤ a.toReal + b.toReal :=
47:   if ha : a = ∞ then by simp only [ha, top_add, toReal_top, zero_add, toReal_nonneg]
48:   else
49:     if hb : b = ∞ then by simp only [hb, add_top, toReal_top, add_zero, toReal_nonneg]
50:     else le_of_eq (toReal_add ha hb)
51: 
52: theorem ofReal_add {p q : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (hq : 0 ≤ q) :
53:     ENNReal.ofReal (p + q) = ENNReal.ofReal p + ENNReal.ofReal q := by
54:   rw [ENNReal.ofReal, ENNReal.ofReal, ENNReal.ofReal, ← coe_add, coe_inj,
55:     Real.toNNReal_add hp hq]
56: 
57: theorem ofReal_add_le {p q : ℝ} : ENNReal.ofReal (p + q) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal p + ENNReal.ofReal q :=
58:   coe_le_coe.2 Real.toNNReal_add_le
59: 
60: @[simp]
61: theorem toReal_le_toReal (ha : a ≠ ∞) (hb : b ≠ ∞) : a.toReal ≤ b.toReal ↔ a ≤ b := by
62:   lift a to ℝ≥0 using ha
63:   lift b to ℝ≥0 using hb
64:   norm_cast
65: 
66: @[gcongr]
67: theorem toReal_mono (hb : b ≠ ∞) (h : a ≤ b) : a.toReal ≤ b.toReal :=
68:   (toReal_le_toReal (ne_top_of_le_ne_top hb h) hb).2 h
69: 
70: theorem toReal_mono' (h : a ≤ b) (ht : b = ∞ → a = ∞) : a.toReal ≤ b.toReal := by
71:   rcases eq_or_ne a ∞ with rfl | ha
72:   · exact toReal_nonneg
73:   · exact toReal_mono (mt ht ha) h
74: 
75: @[simp]
76: theorem toReal_lt_toReal (ha : a ≠ ∞) (hb : b ≠ ∞) : a.toReal < b.toReal ↔ a < b := by
77:   lift a to ℝ≥0 using ha
78:   lift b to ℝ≥0 using hb
79:   norm_cast
80: 
81: @[gcongr]
82: theorem toReal_strict_mono (hb : b ≠ ∞) (h : a < b) : a.toReal < b.toReal :=
83:   (toReal_lt_toReal h.ne_top hb).2 h
84: 
85: @[gcongr]
86: theorem toNNReal_mono (hb : b ≠ ∞) (h : a ≤ b) : a.toNNReal ≤ b.toNNReal :=
87:   toReal_mono hb h
88: 
89: theorem le_toNNReal_of_coe_le (h : p ≤ a) (ha : a ≠ ∞) : p ≤ a.toNNReal :=
90:   @toNNReal_coe p ▸ toNNReal_mono ha h
91: 
92: @[simp]
93: theorem toNNReal_le_toNNReal (ha : a ≠ ∞) (hb : b ≠ ∞) : a.toNNReal ≤ b.toNNReal ↔ a ≤ b :=
94:   ⟨fun h => by rwa [← coe_toNNReal ha, ← coe_toNNReal hb, coe_le_coe], toNNReal_mono hb⟩
95: 
96: @[gcongr]
97: theorem toNNReal_strict_mono (hb : b ≠ ∞) (h : a < b) : a.toNNReal < b.toNNReal := by
98:   simpa [← ENNReal.coe_lt_coe, hb, h.ne_top]
99: 
100: @[simp]
101: theorem toNNReal_lt_toNNReal (ha : a ≠ ∞) (hb : b ≠ ∞) : a.toNNReal < b.toNNReal ↔ a < b :=
102:   ⟨fun h => by rwa [← coe_toNNReal ha, ← coe_toNNReal hb, coe_lt_coe], toNNReal_strict_mono hb⟩
103: 
104: theorem toNNReal_lt_of_lt_coe (h : a < p) : a.toNNReal < p :=
105:   @toNNReal_coe p ▸ toNNReal_strict_mono coe_ne_top h
106: 
107: theorem toReal_max (hr : a ≠ ∞) (hp : b ≠ ∞) :
108:     ENNReal.toReal (max a b) = max (ENNReal.toReal a) (ENNReal.toReal b) :=
109:   (le_total a b).elim
110:     (fun h => by simp only [h, ENNReal.toReal_mono hp h, max_eq_right]) fun h => by
111:     simp only [h, ENNReal.toReal_mono hr h, max_eq_left]
112: 
113: theorem toReal_min {a b : ℝ≥0∞} (hr : a ≠ ∞) (hp : b ≠ ∞) :
114:     ENNReal.toReal (min a b) = min (ENNReal.toReal a) (ENNReal.toReal b) :=
115:   (le_total a b).elim (fun h => by simp only [h, ENNReal.toReal_mono hp h, min_eq_left])
116:     fun h => by simp only [h, ENNReal.toReal_mono hr h, min_eq_right]
117: 
118: theorem toReal_sup {a b : ℝ≥0∞} : a ≠ ∞ → b ≠ ∞ → (a ⊔ b).toReal = a.toReal ⊔ b.toReal :=
119:   toReal_max
120: 
121: theorem toReal_inf {a b : ℝ≥0∞} : a ≠ ∞ → b ≠ ∞ → (a ⊓ b).toReal = a.toReal ⊓ b.toReal :=
122:   toReal_min
123: 
124: theorem toNNReal_pos_iff : 0 < a.toNNReal ↔ 0 < a ∧ a < ∞ := by
125:   induction a <;> simp
126: 
127: theorem toNNReal_pos {a : ℝ≥0∞} (ha₀ : a ≠ 0) (ha_top : a ≠ ∞) : 0 < a.toNNReal :=
128:   toNNReal_pos_iff.mpr ⟨bot_lt_iff_ne_bot.mpr ha₀, lt_top_iff_ne_top.mpr ha_top⟩
129: 
130: theorem toReal_pos_iff : 0 < a.toReal ↔ 0 < a ∧ a < ∞ :=
